archetypes.name: dyn-breadcrumb-publish
archetypes.rationale: Verify missing breadcrumbs directories now publish quiet logs without weakening guards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the run-log breadcrumb publishing change. Focus on whether missing source-dir paths still derive the intended session root and whether confinement, symlink, hardlink, redaction, and no-quiet-log behavior remain intact. Check the commit path test for realistic staging and commit behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
